items.name: Broken-Collar Bracer
items.lore: Iron from a thrall's collar, beaten flat. It was a symbol of one thing. Now it is a symbol of another.

items.name: Freedman's Cloak
items.lore: Grey wool, plain and new. The first thing Ketil ever owned.

items.name: Runaway's Ring
items.lore: A ring hidden in a thrall's mouth for three years.

items.name: Price-Paid Charm
items.lore: A little silver coin, holed and hung on a thong: the last coin of a thrall's price.

items.name: Tomte's Porridge-Spoon
items.lore: A tiny wooden spoon. Leave it out at Yule, and something will thank you.

items.name: Cradle-Quilt Cloak
items.lore: Stitched from a baby's quilt, let out and let out again. It smells of milk and hay.

items.name: Nisse's Red Cap
items.lore: A tomte's pointed red cap, absurdly small. It sits in your pack and somehow helps.

items.name: Barn-Beam Bracer
items.lore: Oak from a barn that burned. It is still warm.
